description_en: You can invoke the ListUserLevelsOfSkillGroup API to retrieve the list of agent skill levels under a specified skill group in a given instance. You can also use this API to retrieve the list of agents who can be associated with but are not currently associated with the specified skill group
description_zh: 调用ListUserLevelsOfSkillGroup获取指定实例下指定技能组下属的坐席技能等级列表，也可以调用该接口反差可关联但未关联指定技能组的坐席列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-user-levels-of-skill-group --instance-id ccc-test --skill-group-id skillgroup@ccc-test --is-member true --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --search-pattern '测试坐席' --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUserLevelsOfSkillGroup

parameters.description_en: Indicates whether to associate with the specified skill group. If the value is true, the operation retrieves the skill level list of agents associated with the skill group ID. If the value is false, the operation retrieves the list of agents that can be associated with but are not currently associated with the skill group ID. The default value is true.
parameters.description_zh: 是否与传入的技能组关联，如果值为true，表示获取SkillgroupId关联的坐席的技能等级列表，如果值为false，表示获取可关联但未关联SkillgroupId的坐席列表。默认值为true。

parameters.description_en: Perform fuzzy matching based on agent logon name or agent display name. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty, which means no filtering is applied.
parameters.description_zh: 根据坐席登录名或坐席展示名进行模糊匹配，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤。
